Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE macOS app icon variant for Ollie. Use the supplied Pocket Otter app icon as reference for the brand family: warm chestnut, cream muzzle, dark ink-teal rounded-square tile, excellent crafted toy-like materials. A single icon centered on a square canvas, tile occupies about 88% of canvas, standard continuous rounded corners. Preserve genuine transparency outside the tile. NO text, no letters, no name, no watermark, no extra buttons or UI, no scene or icon comparison board. Character must look like an otter, with a broad head, low small side ears, wide cream whisker pads; no teddy-bear ears on top. Keep silhouette clean and readable at 32px.
Edit target: the supplied icon.
Primary request: make this same Pocket Otter visibly happy and more lively. Keep its chestnut and cream body, grey pebble held by both paws, ink-teal tile, scale and polished soft-touch vinyl material. Give it a small open joyful smile with a tiny pink tongue and no teeth, lifted cream cheeks, soft cheerful upturned eyes with glossy dark highlights, and a slight 8-degree head tilt. Lower and reduce the ears so the character feels like a sea otter. Add just two short tidy whiskers each side, no dense fur. The happiness should be obvious in thumbnail, sweet and natural, not exaggerated or manic. Keep the icon otherwise faithful to the original.
